notes: Ollama is configured two ways at once: OLLAMA_* environment variables on the server and per-request options in the API body. Both are fingerprinted as flags here, with the env variable recorded in the param's env field. num-gpu = -1 means Ollama decides the layer split from free VRAM, so two runs of the same nominal config on the same box can differ; record the layer count the server logged.

params.name: num-ctx
params.help: Context window in tokens for the loaded model.

params.name: num-batch
params.help: Prompt processing batch size.

params.name: num-gpu
params.help: Layers offloaded to the GPU. -1 lets Ollama decide, which is the single most common source of unreproducible Ollama numbers.

params.name: num-thread
params.help: CPU threads. 0 means auto.

params.name: num-predict
params.help: Maximum tokens to generate. -1 is unlimited.

params.name: num-keep
params.help: Tokens kept from the prompt when the context is shifted.

params.name: temperature
params.help: Sampling temperature.

params.name: top-k
params.help: Top-k sampling.

params.name: top-p
params.help: Top-p sampling.

params.name: min-p
params.help: Min-p sampling.

params.name: repeat-penalty
params.help: Repetition penalty.

params.name: seed
params.help: Random seed.

params.name: ollama-flash-attention
params.help: Enable flash attention in the runner.

params.name: ollama-kv-cache-type
params.help: KV cache quantization for the runner. Requires flash attention for the quantized types.

params.name: ollama-num-parallel
params.help: Concurrent requests per loaded model. 0 lets Ollama choose (usually 4 or 1 depending on free memory).

params.name: ollama-max-loaded-models
params.help: Models kept resident at once. 0 means 3 x GPU count.

params.name: ollama-max-queue
params.help: Queued requests before the server returns 503.

params.name: ollama-sched-spread
params.help: Spread a model across all GPUs instead of packing it into the fewest.

params.name: ollama-new-engine
params.help: Use the new Go inference engine instead of the llama.cpp runner. Different code path, different numbers.

params.name: ollama-gpu-overhead
params.help: Bytes of VRAM per GPU to leave unused.

params.name: keep-alive
params.help: How long a model stays resident after the last request. Dropped from the fingerprint.

params.name: ollama-host
params.help: Bind address. Dropped from the fingerprint.

params.name: ollama-models
params.help: Model storage directory. Dropped from the fingerprint.

params.name: ollama-debug
params.help: Verbose logging. Dropped from the fingerprint.
